description: Android Fragment class for managing synchronized notifications between handset and wearable devices, including building local, wearable-only, and mirrored notifications, and handling GoogleApiClient connections.

classes.name: SynchronizedNotificationsFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages notifications and data sync with a wearable device, implementing GoogleApiClient callbacks.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes GoogleApiClient and sets options menu.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections to trigger different notification builds.

methods.name: buildLocalOnlyNotification
methods.description: Creates a local notification, optionally with a dismissal intent to mirror dismissal.

methods.name: buildWearableOnlyNotification
methods.description: Creates a data item for a wearable-only notification.

methods.name: buildMirroredNotifications
methods.description: Creates both local and wearable notifications that are linked for synchronized dismissal.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Returns current time as a formatted string.
